unverified.model: kling-4.0 (image to video), kling-4.0-flash (image to video), seedream-5-pro, seedream-5-lite, image-upscaler
unverified.detail: No way to refer to references in the prompt is documented; the fallback form (Image1, Video1, Audio1) is used.
The schema enum omits 'adaptive' but the enum labels, playground and FAQ list it. 'adaptive' is offered.
Kie documents per-kind limits (9 images, 3 videos, 3 audio) but no total. Capped at 12, the total PiAPI documents for the same model in two places (a third place says 15).
Kie documents no total; the per-kind sum (50) matches the total PiAPI documents.
Kie does not say whether audio-only references are allowed. Rejected to avoid a paid failure (PiAPI forbids it for Seedance 2; PiAPI allows it for Seedance 2.5).
The schema does not mark the prompt required (Seedance 2 docs do). Treated as required.
Kie documents no asset-creation API or real-face behaviour. References pass through unchanged; real-face references may be rejected by the upstream model.

unverified.model: seedance-2, seedance-2-fast, seedance-2-mini, seedance-2.5, wan-3.0, seedream-*
unverified.detail: The API docs say it defaults to false; the playground says it defaults to true. The ledger default is false and the value is always sent explicitly.
Sent as 'reference' for Omni Reference requests so edit/extend are never inferred. Not sent for text or frame requests (documented as rejected there).
Keyframe-to-video does not mark the first frame required. Image to Video requires it; last-frame-only requests are not offered.

Kie has no audio field for this model: audio references are sent as the API's `voices` list, named sound_1, sound_2, ... in order (`audio_N` is a reserved name there). Up to 3 are documented; their formats, size and duration limits are undocumented, and whether audio alone (without images or videos) is allowed is undocumented. Audio-only requests are rejected. Kie's doc says the task fails if no usable voice can be detected, so audio without speech (music, ambience) may be rejected by the provider; this is untested.
No formats or file-size limits are documented for Kling 4.0 references on Kie.
No total reference limit is documented; only per-kind limits are enforced.
Both are required with no documented default. The ledger defaults to 'basic' and '1:1' and always sends them.
Documented as 'set this field explicitly' with no default. Defaults to 'png' and is always sent.
No nsfw_checker or less-restriction control is documented for these models on Kie.

Kie documents no failure codes for content rejection. A failed task is classified as content_rejected only when failMsg mentions sensitive content, a content policy or review, a violation, NSFW, moderation or safety.
Listed in the response code enum with no meaning. Treated as a provider failure.

Get Task Details documents five states (waiting, queuing, generating, success, fail) and no cancelled or expired state. Any other state is treated as an unknown response: the job keeps polling and fails as malformed_response after several such answers in a row.

Insufficient credits is documented only as response code 402, which is classified as insufficient_credits. No failCode or failMsg for it on a failed task is documented, so a failed task is never classified as insufficient_credits.
The description calls mode optional (inferred); the schema marks it required. Always sent.
Documented as 1-12 in two places and 1-15 in one. Capped at 12.
One page says 100 MB per video, another 50 MB. Capped at 50 MB.
One page says 15.4 s total, the material spec says 15 s. Capped at 15 s.
The schema says it defaults to true; the Private Asset guide says false and returns 400 on strict task types. Never sent on strict task types; always sent explicitly on less-restriction.
The Private Asset guide lists only seedance-2 and seedance-2-fast less-restriction as supported for assets. Mini and 2.5 asset support is not confirmed; a warning is returned.
Not in the schema, but every example sends it ('text_to_video' / 'omni_reference'). Sent.
Mentioned only as fields to omit in draft step 2; not in the schema. Not exposed.
No formats, size or dimension limits are documented for Seedance 2.5 images.
Image URLs are described as usable for image-to-video, but no first/last frame semantics are documented. Image to Video is not offered on PiAPI for Seedance 2.5.
No prompt length limit is documented.
The overview lists jpeg/png/webp; the schema lists png/jpeg. Only png and jpeg are offered.

PiAPI documents Kling 4.0 omni_video_generation, but a real submit on 2026-11-18 (kling-4.0, one image and one video reference, 720p, 5 s) was refused with: "Kling 4.0 Omni generation is not available yet. Use video_generation, text_to_video, or image_to_video." Nothing was charged. Not offered on PiAPI for Kling 4.0 or Kling 4.0 Flash: Flash was sent through the same omni_video_generation task type with only version '4.0-flash' differing, and was not tried. Re-check both with a real run before offering it again.
Both appear required with no documented default. Defaults are 2 and false, always sent.

The Get Task pages differ per model (pending, staged, starting, processing, retry, completed, success, failed). A canceled status is documented only for models not offered here, and the provider-side cancel is not used. Any other status is treated as an unknown response: the job keeps polling and fails as malformed_response after several such answers in a row.
The response schema is empty; balance fields are read best-effort.
No HTTP or body error-code table is documented except error.code 10003 (unknown fields) and the upload 403 (plan). Errors are classified by HTTP status and message keywords.
